text_blocks.snippet: Central Illinois residents are heavily targeted by fake government texts, imposter scams, and storm-chaser fraud. Scammers frequently send fraudulent texts impersonating the Illinois Secretary of State regarding fake traffic/toll violations, or pose as the Better Business Bureau. Additionally, after storms, unverified contractors often solicit door-to-door, requiring cash upfront and delivering poor repairs.
Protect yourself and verify suspicious activity with these regional and federal resources:

list.snippet:
Verify Traffic or Toll Notices: Official government agencies will never threaten to suspend your license via an unsolicited text message. Check your status directly on the Illinois Tollway
or the Illinois Secretary of State websites.
Hire Contractors Safely: Avoid door-to-door repair pitches demanding cash upfront. Check a contractor's legitimacy with the Illinois Attorney General and ask for references.

Report Fraud: File a report or track local schemes using the FTC Report Fraud tool or check community warnings on the BBB Scam Tracker
.
